text: Malkovitch was a marine in service to the Terran Dominion. He had a penchant for smoking cigars, even with the visor of his CMC armor down. A few months after the Dominion's founding, Alpha Squadron was dispatched to Char in order to "flush out" the zerg. Alpha Squadron was on the receiving end of the casualties, however, which included the zerg overrunning the science vessel Amerigo. In response, a demolition team, Malkovitch included, was sent to investigate and, if any zerg were present, to destroy it. The marines brought a high yield explosive with them, along with a number of beverages. However, zerg hydralisks interrupted their drinking session, prompting the marines to open fire. Malkovitch initially held his own, keeping the hydralisks at bay effectively -- even dispatching one with a few bullets, until one of the creatures attacked him from above, killing him instantly.

Max Zander was a marine in the Confederate Marine Corps. He was a short but strong hollow-faced man who knew his way around a truck engine. During the Guild Wars he was assigned to the of the Special Tactics and Mission Platoon, 321st Colonial Rangers Battalion. He used a man-portable grenade launcher and would often carry ten grenades over his authorized loadout, something a larger man couldn't get away with.

Marduke Saul was a criminal who was arrested in for murder, assault and terrorism. He sentenced to El Indio Prison on Mar Sara, but was allowed a second chance at redemption when he helped Marshal Jim Raynor rescue a group of slaves from the Mazor gang. He was a burly man with a bald head, jet black mustache, and arms as thick as telecom poles, with a body covered in tattoos.

NVG Mosh Pit is a Game Mode featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, added on December 10th, 2019. It was playable on the night variants of Azhir Cave, Gun Runner and Hackney Yard, taking place on Team Deathmatch, Kill Confirmed, Domination, Hardpoint and Headquarters, however, with increased time and score limits. It was a 6v6 playlist taking place exclusively in Hardcore.

Natale was a terran who lived on Tarsonis, employed as a servant of the Terra Family. It was an affiliation that got her killed, caught up in a terrorist raid on the family. However, she died along with her attackers, courtesy of an unregistered telepath, her last thoughts centered on her regret that she would never see her mother again.
Dr. Morrigan was a high-ranking archaeologist working for the Moebius Foundation. She had minor telepathic abilities.
Mukav was a zerg queen serving under Overqueen Zagara years after the End War, but secretly serving Abathur and his coup against Zagara.
The Motorcycle is a vehicle featured on Battle Royale mode in Call of Duty: Mobile. It was added as part of the Season 3 update.
Polek was a reaper trainee conscripted into Icehouse. He was a large man who bullied others to establish dominance.

Pollock Rimes was a military officer for the nascent Sons of Korhal, although, in truth, he was a spy for the Confederacy. Predjudiced against Fringe Worlders, he was known as not being scared of anything; he was also very competent and a fierce warrior. Rimes was bald and scarred, with a mostly missing left ear, a previous-broken nose, crooked teeth and an indentation on the left side of his skull. He rarely smiled.

"Rip" was the name for a terran ghost coined by Nova Terra and Malcolm Kelerchian. She had a shaved head and rippling muscles, hence the nickname. In 2503, she was one of a number of ghosts assigned to the pair as part of the counter-insurgency against Project Shadowblade. Alongside them, she was dispatched to Altara, the team assembling entirely on the Palatine a few days later. Later, Rip was assigned to the team to defend Arcturus Mengsk from a spectre uprising. However, the group were attacked by spectres and swiftly overwhelmed. The ghosts managed to hold the palace and prevent the Emperor's assassination, but at great cost; all but two ghosts had been killed, and those two had been captured and indoctrinated into the spectre program. It is unknown if Rip was killed or indoctrinated.

The Mk3 Burst Mod is a barrel attachment exclusive to the Renetti in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Warzone. It converts the weapon from semi automatic to 3 round burst with a small decrease to recoil control.

Rosemary Dahl (often known only as R. M. Dahl), a major character in the Dark Templar Saga, is a cold-hearted mercenary who works for Valerian Mengsk. Considered very beautiful, she is very small but hard-muscled; her appearance has fooled several opponents into a sense of complacency about her abilities.

Segard Yohansen was a terran who lived on the world of Bountiful, running a farm about a mile outside Helaman Township. As he is only mentioned in the memories of neurally resocialized marine Ardo Melnikov, exactly whether he existed is nebulous. In Ardo's manufactured memories, the zerg invaded Bountiful, Yohansen's fields instantly ruined by a fireball. Most likely the invasion never occurred however and Yohansen is still alive.

Sherman Jack is a xeno-imaging specialist at Project Blackstone. His scans weren't shielded, and when Adjutant 33-27_V3.1974 detected this and told Major Lee Treicher, the latter was annoyed and demanded Mr. Jack's presence. Major Treicher wanted Jack to find a safe place for his scans, or he would "find himself floating home."
The is a special weapon featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War, Call of Duty: Mobile, and Call of Duty: Black Ops 6.

Serj was a port grub who lived in Deadman's Port. He befriended a fellow port grub named Vik, but the two fell into the gang of the crime lord Ivan. He was a large man, with an surprising intellect for his upbringing. Serj attempted to escape the gang but was killed.

Scarlip is a terran living at Dead Man's Rock. He is a large man with an imposing presence, with a large scar that runs down his face, severing his lip. This caused him to speak with a slur. Scarlip has a son, who he is protective of. When Scarlip's son begged an undercover Matt Horner for money during the Flashpoint Conflict, Horner pushed him away. This caused Scarlip and two of his friends to attack Horner and Valerian Mengsk. Valerian beat him and his lackeys using marshal arts, impressing Horner. The crown prince spared Scarlip rather than killing him, as he did not want to deprive a child of a father.

Rylan was a patron of Dante's Circle in Augustgrad, and a man of large stature. In 2511, he and a group of patrons came to the bar in remembrance of the purification of Chau Sara. However, a protoss named Ulavu came to the bar in order to study the terran reactions. Rylan, drunk at the time, moved to confront the protoss, but was interrupted when the ghost assigned to keep an eye on the protoss, Tanya Caulfield, arrived. Initially she tried to talk him down, but Rylan became enraged, and attacked. In response, Tanya threw a cup of alcohol at him, heated by her pyrokinesis just between 45 and 50 degrees Celsius, enough to cause first degree burns. The liquid scalded his face, allowing Tanya and Ulavu the time to escape Dante's Circle. Tanya speculated that the liquid would have caused no permanent injuries.

The Mortar 50 Short Barrel is a barrel for the JAK Harbinger Kit of the M4 Assault Rifle. It is featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III as part of the Aftermarket Parts system and was added as part of the Season Four update.

The stank is a variant strain of the ultralisk. During the Second Great War, a number of them were spawned on Meinhoff. Later, they appeared on a fringe Terran Dominion colony of Chazington, and allied commanders were called in to destroy them.

Lieutenant Colonel Sparks was a Moebius Corps officer who was in charge of security for the Revanscar facility. His office desk was immaculate, and the walls were covered with various commendations. He possessed some proficiency in hand-to-hand combat, despite his age.

The slayer is the Tal'darim variant of the stalker. Slayers are Tal'darim who chose not to pursue ascension, opting instead to perfect their combat skills in their current role. They take great pride in their ability to slay the Highlord's foes.
Mobile Suit Gundam Legends was an event featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III and Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0 available between June 5th and June 19th, 2024.
trainee Kath Toom uses telepathy]] Telepathy is a basic psionic power, possessed by various species.
The is one of Ibuki's special attacks, introduced in the Street Fighter III series.
Dragon Knuckle is a move used by Marshall Law since Tekken 4. His son Forest Law can also use this move in Tekken Tag Tournament 2.
The is an assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6.
Diving Falcon is a move used by Ling Xiaoyu since Tekken 6. Since its introduction, the attack will automatically transition the user to Phoenix.
Flamingo Pick is a move used by Baek Doo San since his first appearance in Tekken 2 until Tekken 5: Dark Resurrection, where it was removed.

Poison Touch is a move used by Lee Chaolan since Tekken 6: Bloodline Rebellion to occupy the command previously used by Mist Illusion. Lee performs this move during his Hitman stance. In this move, Lee goes for one-two punches on his opponent.

The [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nagato-class_battleship Nagato-class battleships] (長門型戦艦, Nagato-gata senkan) were Japanese dreadnought battleships built for the Imperial Japanese Navy. They saw service in the World War II. They appear exclusively in Call of Duty: World at War (Nintendo DS). Three Nagato-class battleships appear in the level Silence the Guns, they can be seen after climbing the hill. Preparing to bombard the Marine positions. The initial objectives to destroy the Coastal Guns change as the the Marines, under the command of Cpt. Lamansky, decide to capture the Japanese FlaK 88s. Pvt. Rook captures the first gun and disables a Nagato. He then destroys the gun with TNT before moving on to capture the second gun to do the same to the other two ships. Although the Nagatos do begin shelling the bunkers, they are unable to stop Rook from taking them out of the fight.
The Heavenly Slime is an enemy frequently summoned by the Queen Slime alongside Crystal Slimes and Bouncy Slimes. It flies around trying to ram into the player.

The shape family are a trio of minor characters in The Amazing World of Gumball. They made their first appearance in "The End," where they can be seen standing across the street for a split-second before the bus pulls up, and obscures the audience's view of them. They get an expanded role in "The Extras."
Wizoobs are ghost enemies that disappear, then reappear near Isaac and spit a cluster of spectral tears at him. While they can appear to any side of Isaac, they most often will appear below him.

The Model 94 Isuzu truck was the main truck of the Imperial Japanese Army during World War II. It was used to move supplies and troops. It is encountered frequently in the Pacific campaign of Call of Duty: World at War and one of the campaign levels in Call of Duty: Vanguard, Numa Numa Trail.

The pride of Minneapolis. She dreamt of becoming the first lefty pitcher to bring home the gold. Until she tore her rotator cuff freshman year. She lost her athletic scholarship, enlisted in the Army and was recruited by the Black Tusk, where she used that mean curveball to lob grenades into orphanages.

Derek "Del" Uglio is Billy's long lost twin brother, despite the fact that they neither look anything alike nor even look to be in the same age group, because they both have a birthmark that combines to create a map to an ancient treasure. His name is supposed to translate into "The Ugly", but the correct Spanish for it would be, "El Feo". He is a Mexican wrestler with a high temper and is considered the ugliest man on Earth. He calls Billy "hermano", which is Spanish for "brother". In truth, he is actually incredibly handsome, however he and everyone who sees his face considers him ugly for whatever reason. At one point, Harold lampshades how Del Uglio could possibly be his son when he says: "...and I got the son I never knew I had because it doesn't even seem possible". He appears in the episode "El Dia De Los Muertos Estupidos" and has never reappeared on the show again, nor was he referenced as Billy's brother. This was most likely due to his debut being the penultimate episode and the show’s negative continuity. es:Del Uglio

King Triceps is the wrestling champion king of Gogan Land in "Hey, Water You Doing?". He is very hotheaded, loud-mouthed, violent and immature. He is very muscular, as indicated by his name, and often wears shades. He has a daughter named Hariel and he is friends with Billy, but enemies with Uvula.
Private Nelson is an American soldier who fought in World War II with the 1st Infantry Division under the command of Lt. Walker, as seen in Call of Duty: Finest Hour.

&nbsp Wanda is a character that only appeared in the episode Just the 2 of Pus. She works at a psychic and a skin doctor. She is also very flatulent and makes the smoke affects with her farts. She is voiced by Joan Van Ark.

Adunae is the Witch King's most trusted lieutenant in the war against the kingdom of Men. An accomplished commander, she also enjoys fighting in the front lines, cutting enemies with her scythe, which earned her the title "Reaper of Angmar".

Bard, known also as Bard the Bowman and Bard I, was a Man of Lake-town, the slayer of the dragon Smaug, and founder and first king of the renewed kingdom of Dale. He was succeeded as King of Dale by his son, Bain.
Nevada Camouflage is a type of weapon camouflage skin featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops and Call of Duty: Black Ops II.

Badger-folk were creatures of Middle-earth mentioned in Hobbit verse and folklore. They were among the Forest-folk in the Old Forest, though nothing is known about their origins. At some point, Tom Bombadil was captured by the Badger-folk and then released when he frightened them with his renowned magical chants.

Arwen Undómiel's grave was found in the woods of Lothlórien, after she was laid to rest in the Fourth Age. She had been the wife of Aragorn II Elessar and Queen of the Reunited Kingdom, having chosen a mortal life in order to remain with him, giving up the immortality natural to her kind.

Az-Harto, more commonly known as "Ranger", was an Olog-hai who was rescued by the Uruk Ratbag. Since then, they built up a reputation of being "The Etten", a two-headed troll. He is non-canonical as he does not appear in the works of J.R.R. Tolkien, and only in the video game Middle-earth: Shadow of War. In Middle-earth: Shadow of War, Ranger is an Olog-hai who only speaks Black Speech. He can speak the common tongue but decides not to as he thinks it's a sin that Ratbag can't speak any Black Speech. Since Ratbag doesn't understand Black Speech, he thinks Ranger is dumb. As such, Ratbag gives him the nickname "Ranger" in honor of Talion. When Ratbag saves him, Ranger returns the favor by staying with him and protecting him. Eventually, the ranger Talion and his bodyguard Brûz took over the fortress of Núrn, of which Ranger had become the overlord, though Talion appointed a different overlord afterwards.
New Alliance is the ninth level of Call of Duty: Black Ops (Nintendo DS), where the player must fight against enemy forces from behind an American truck with the help of his new American allies.

Badger-brock was one of the Badger-folk mentioned in Hobbit verse and folklore. He lived with his wife and many sons in a secret house near the Withywindle. One day, he kidnapped Tom Bombadil, dragging him to his burrow. However, Tom scared all the Badger-folk there with his singing power, and they released him.

Boromir was a valiant warrior of Gondor, renowned for his prowess in combat and skill on the battlefield. He was the eldest son of Denethor II, who was Steward of Gondor during the War of the Ring, and his wife Finduilas. Even the people of Rohan admired him, particularly Éomer. He was the older brother of Faramir, the eventual brother-in-law of Éowyn and the uncle of Elboron.

Brian Blessed (born October 9, 1936) is an English comedian, actor, narrator, and writer known for his memorable booming voice, giant persona, and substantial experience in [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/William_Shakespeare Shakespearean] cinema and theater. He began acting in 1962, and has appeared in dozens of films and almost a hundred TV shows, voiced characters in sixteen video games, and hosted some documentaries. He starred in [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blackadder The Black Adder] alongside Stephen Fry, Hugh Laurie, and Rowan Atkinson, as [https://blackadder.fandom.com/wiki/King_Richard_IV King Richard IV], and in [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I,_Claudius I, Claudius] alongside Derek Jacobi, Christopher Guard, and John Rhys-Davies as Caesar Augustus. In 1992, Blessed provided the voice of Farmer Giles in BBC Radio 5's series of Tales from the Perilous Realm, which also featured Brian Sibley. He lives in [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Windlesham Windlesham], Surrey, England.

No Man's Land is the third campaign mission in Call of Duty: Ghosts. David "Hesh" Walker, Logan and Riley must recon their way through a demilitarized zone spanning from Los Angeles south to San Diego, being fought for between Ghosts and the Federation in their ongoing war. It is a stealth/reconnaissance mission, in which the player must take out enemy soldiers silently.

Shelob was a great Spider and the greatest offspring of Ungoliant, the primordial spider. In the Third Age she lived on the borders of Mordor and was known to feed indiscriminately, preying on the inhabitants. She was encountered by Frodo Baggins and Samwise Gamgee in their quest to destroy the One Ring.
Tilion was the Maia who guided the Moon. While lesser in power than his counterpart Arien, he gained stewardship of the Moon earlier.
Thrugg was an Uruk-hai Berserker who was one of the leaders that commanded Saruman's army during the Battle of the Hornburg.
Nebula Personalization Pack is a downloadable content package available for Call of Duty: Ghosts. It contains a weapon camo, reticle, a player background and a player patch.

The Vile Creature is an enemy creature in the The Hobbit (2003 video game). They are armless two-legged frog-like hybrids that appear in the Roast Mutton level. At some point they breathe poisonous gas at Bilbo. In one area, they also fight wolves. It is unknown if any of them work for the Dark Lords.

Amarthiel is a character created specifically for The Lord of the Rings Online. She is the main antagonist in The Lord of the Rings Online: Shadows of Angmar. Although she plays a large part in the game, she doesn't appear in her true form until late in the main storyline, instead manifesting herself as Sara Oakheart, and tricking the player to help her. Many of the quests in the latter part of the game deal with Amarthiel's obsession with finding her ring, the Narchuil. She is shown to be able to appear in the guise of those she has killed, a tool which plays a great part in the storyline.

Agatha was Farmer Giles' wife. When Garm woke up the two of them with the news of the Giant's arrival, she first recommended drowning the dog, but when Giles indicated that he believed the dog she told him to be bold and quick. When Giles became king of the Little Kingdom, Agatha became a queen of great size and majesty. She was known to keep a tight account upon the household. de:Agatha fi:Agatha

The Nightbreaker (referred to as Bone Glass in the game files) is a melee weapon in Call of Duty: Black Ops III that was added in the June 14, 2016 update. It can be obtained only through supply drops. However, it can be picked up by bots that used it. It can be acquired in Revelations by completing 20 rounds in under 32 minutes. In terms of appearance, it's much like the Brass Knuckles, albeit with pointed ends coming above and below the hand, and looking more like a set of sharp fangs.
Artaxerxes is the wizard, and main antagonist, in Roverandom. Artaxerxes is described as an old man in ragged trousers wearing a green hat with a blue feather.

Bellomarius was the greatest dragon-slayer that the realm of the Middle Kingdom had ever known. He was said to be the maternal great-great-grandfather of Augustus Bonifacius, who was the king of the Middle Kingdom when Farmer Giles lived in the realm. He had also owned a famous sword called Caudimordax which had languished in the king's armoury. When Farmer Giles chased off a giant that had come to the village of Ham, the king made a present of the sword to the rustic. Thus, in a sense, Giles was the heir of Bellomarius. fi:Bellomarius

In Middle-earth Role Playing and the Collectible Card Game, Bairanax the “Bear-hunter” was a Cold-drake in the Grey Mountains. He has brownish-red scales and measures fifty-five feet in length. When he escaped the doom of Angband as a young dragon, a North Bear almost killed him. This instilled a deep hatred of bears into the dragon. Likewise, Northman Bear-cults view him as their ancient enemy. Beyond Bears, Bairanax has a rivalry with the dragon Lomaw. ]] The lair of Bairanax was situated in the caves at Ovir Hollow, surrounded by a flower-filled moat, somewhere in the southern Grey Mountains.
The , more commonly known as Nunchaku, are a melee weapon featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops III, Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare, Call of Duty: Mobile, and Call of Duty: Black Ops 6.

- Hill Trolls]] Etten is an obscure term in Westron that probably refers to monsters like Trolls or Ogres. The Ettenmoors, and the Ettendales which were a part of the Ettenmoors, were probably named after these beings. The Ettenmoors were also called the troll-fells, probably because the region was inhabited by trolls. Aragorn mentioned that the Ettendales were troll-country and little-known to him. Specifically hill-trolls were seen in the lands north of Rivendell.

Halbrand was a name and identity that Sauron took for himself during the late Second Age of Middle-earth. Halbrand was invented by Amazon Studios for The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power. He is portrayed by Charlie Vickers.

Oghor-hai was the name used by the Orcs to describe that race of Men otherwise known as the Drúedain or Woses. They were believed by the Orcs to possess magical powers, and they therefore feared the Oghor-hai greatly.
The Nine Ring Sword is a melee weapon featured in Call of Duty Online.
The slave-drivers were the two large and fierce uruks that led the Durthang line from the Orc-hold of Durthang to the Morannon during the War of the Ring.
Tavros was the chief wood-fay, described as the "Blue Spirit of the Woods", according to the early version of the legendarium associated with The Book of Lost Tales. His home was called Inthavros.

]] Tom Bombadil's mythological origins in the internal cosmology of Middle-earth have puzzled even erudite fans. For example, the fact that the Ring had no power on Tom would either suggest that Tom existed in both the Seen and the Unseen realms or that the Unseen had no effect on him since "He is his own master". Speculative ideas about his true nature range from simply a wise Elven hermit to a Maia or Vala, to even Ilúvatar himself.

O.D. Green Camouflage (or Olive Drab Green Camouflage) is a type of weapon camouflage skin featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered. It is unlocked after achieving 75 kills on a specific weapon without any attachments equipped for all primary weapons except the XM-LAR, which requires 50 kills without any attachments, 25 kills without attachments on all pistols, or for the case of the Desert Eagle and MP44, 25 kills and 75 kills while crouching respectively. This camouflage appears as a drab, olive color scheme.
The Lithards are a species of extraterrestrial dragonoid creatures who appear in Brian Lumley's Titus Crow series of Cthulhu Mythos novels.

Lu-Kthu, otherwise known as Lew-Kthew or the Birth-womb of the Great Old Ones, is an Outer God who first appeared in James Ambuehl's short story "Correlated Contents", published in 1998. Ambuehl is an American horror writer who has expanded H. P. Lovecraft's Cthulhu Mythos with the creation of the Lu-Kthu Cycle or Pantheon of Lu-Kthu.

Captain Nemo is a fictional character created by the late French author Jules Verne, a pioneer of the science fiction genre. He first appeared in the 1870 novel Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Seas. Given Nemo's history of adventures in the depths of the ocean, it is perhaps unsurprising that the character has found its way into the Cthulhu Mythos in a variety of mediums.

Major Nicholas Rado is a character who appears in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare and member of the Settlement Defense Front. He's assigned to the SetDef carrier Cerberus. Rado is killed by Nick Reyes in a dogfight during Operation Phoenix.

Robert Martin Olmstead (: "Notes for The Shadow Over Innsmouth") is the narrator of The Shadow Over Innsmouth. It is remarked that his eyes have the same strange quality seen in all descendants of Obed Marsh. In the story's final pages, he learns he himself is the great-great-grandson of Obed Marsh and a Deep One, and in time will become one of the amphibious monsters he witnessed in Innsmouth. Growing up in Toledo, he journeys to Massachusetts and stops at Innsmouth almost by chance, as it is on the way from Newburyport to Arkham, while on a journey to discover more of his family roots. Olmstead's name is never given within the original story, but is given as Robert Martin Olmstead in Lovecraft's notes for the story. In "The Watcher from the Sky", by August Derleth, a character refers to the Shadow Over Innsmouth narrator as Williamson. In the original story, James Williamson was the name of Olmstead's maternal grandfather.

Sirens, also spelled Syrens, are a species of unearthly female sea creatures in Greek mythology, known for their ability to enthrall men with their singing. Traditionally, they have been depicted as woman-headed birds who inhabit rocky islands and cliffs. The Sirens first appear in the Homeric epic poem, the Odyssey. They were traditionally believed to be sired by Phorcys who mated with the sea monster Ceto, immortal creatures whom use their voice to lure men to their deaths. According to one source, the Syrens were banished from the Earth's surface in ancient times and exiled to the abyssal depths of the oceans, where their descendants became known as the Spawn of the Green Abyss, ruled by their queen Zoth Syra. (: "Spawn of the Green Abyss")
Xirdneth, also known as the Maker of Illusions, is a fictional entity created by the American author James Ambuehl for his 1996 Cthulhu Mythos short story "The Star-Seed."

Nuclear is a Legendary gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare, found upon certain weapon variants. It allows the player to earn a De-Atomizer Strike once they reach a 25 killstreak. Players are unable to earn a De-Atomizer Strike with other scorestreaks. Nuclear also has a similar effect in Zombies mode. Once the player kills 150 zombies without being downed, a Nuke will spawn, ready for the player to collect. Oddly, the perk is available on all firearms present in Multiplayer with the sole exceptions of the Kendall 44 and the Widowmaker. It is unknown why these two lack a variant with the perk.

Wendell Trepan is a fictional character who appears in Philip José Farmer's short story "The Freshman". He is an upperclassman at Miskatonic University and chairperson of the rushing committee for the Lam Kha Alif fraternity, Farmer provides a description of Trepan: Trepan has minor magical abilities--for example, the ability to temporarily relax magical protections on books. He claims to be the descendant of "the Cornish witch, Rachel Trepan". She is said to be from "Tredannick Wollas near Poldhu Bay"; the body of water is real, the village is a fictional one that appears in the Sherlock Holmes story "The Adventure of the Devil's Foot".
Gordon has a winch which he uses to help other engines out of trouble. The winch can be mounted to his front bufferbeam and has strong cables.

:Booster X10 is a Decepticon Real Gear Robot from the Movie continuity family. Booster X10 is one of the many small Transformers who were once normal machines brought to life by the power of the All Spark. Booster X10 loves to mess with his user's head, and he does that through messing with their ears. Sound manipulation is his specialty, and not only can he record and playback sound, but alter still-in-the-air soundwaves. He laughs to himself, knowing how much trouble and strife he can cause with a warped word in conversation, or changing something like an ambulance siren into a barking dog. : French-Canadian name: Ampli X10 : Spanish name: Amplificador X10
The Nauticus is a melee weapon that was added to Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered on the June 27th, 2017 update. It resembles a harpoon head which extends when equipping the weapon.
Edwin Eugene "Buzz" Aldrin, Jr. (born January 20, 1930) is a NASA astronaut and pilot on the Apollo 11 mission. He has a hell of a right hook. {| class="fandom-table" |

:The Creepozoid is a character in the Marvel Comics Generation One continuity family. The Creepozoid is an animatronic prop for the movie Creepozoids of the Crab Nebula, directed by Rollie Friendly. It doesn't seem to be particularly OHS safe, given a short circuit causes it to erupt in flames, but given Friendly Studios' other dubious practices it's not surprising. The machine was scheduled to be fixed in three months, but the hiring of Skullgrin put that plan on hold. It is unknown if it was ever repaired, or the film completed.

:Decepticon Sixbuilder is a Decepticon Micromaster-composed super robot from the Micromaster Collection portion of the Generation One continuity family. The combined form of the Decepticon Build Team, Decepticon Sixbuilder is an evil version of Sixbuilder on a mission of destruction. He and Sixbuilder were apparently once one and the same, but were split into separate robots at some point; the details of this are unknown. He intends to recombine with the Autobot Sixbuilder someday, after all other Autobots have been destroyed. Decepticon Sixbuilder's component robots are all green copies of Sixbuilder's component robots, and consist of... * Bonecrusher, the bulldozer and counterpart to Crush-Bull (and presumably the leader). * Gren, the crane and counterpart to Iron Lift. * Long Haul, the dump truck and counterpart to Treader. * Mixmaster, the cement mixer and counterpart to Mixing. * Scavenger, the excavator and counterpart to Digger. * Scrapper, the front-end loader and counterpart to Gran Arm. :Original Japanese name: Destron Sixbuilder

The Nifo'oti is a melee weapon that was added to Call of Duty: Black Ops 4 with the Operation Spectre Rising update. It is a wooden Samoan war club with metal teeth on one side with the other being a hook club, the handle is wrapped in twine. The designs carved into the club are of traditional Samoan style.
Darth Maul is the sith apprentice to [http://starwars.wikia.com/wiki/Darth_Sidious Darth Sidious]. He transforms into his Sith Interceptor.

Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson (born May 2, 1972) used to be a professional wrestler for WWE, where he is a ten-time world champion (eight-time WWE Championship and two-time World Heavyweight Championship). He eventually left to pursue a movie career, though in recent years he has made a few returns to the ring in a publicity capacity, even participating in some storylines and matches. He is best known for starring in the Fast & Furious and Jumanji franchises, The Mummy Returns, The Scorpion King, Black Adam and other films of various genres such as family (The Game Plan, Race to Witch Mountain, Tooth Fairy, Jungle Cruise), action adventure (Journey 2: The Mysterious Island, G.I. Joe: Retaliation, Hercules, Skyscraper, San Andreas, Rampage), and action comedy (Get Smart, Central Intelligence, Baywatch, Red Notice). He also voiced Maui in Moana and Krypto the Superdog in DC League of Super-Pets.
Powered by the mysterious energy known as Nite-Glow, Freezon seems to have a thing for shining the light on her fellow Decepticons' interpersonal affairs.

The ORV is a four seater 4x4 Off-Road vehicle featured on Battle Royale mode in Call of Duty: Mobile. It is generally considered not the best vehicle to use due to its size and being incredibly loud overall. The ORV is extremely slow at going up sloped surfaces and is quite slow in general.
:Jake Jackson is a human from the Generation One continuity family. !"]] Jake "The Jackhammer" Jackson is a wrestling champion from New York City. He ain't afraid of robots.

John Keller is Secretary of Defense of the United States of America. He not only seems to pretty much run the country while the President of the United States binges on Ding-Dongs, but he's also rather handy with a shotgun. He doesn't want to hear any of this alien robot crap.

: Knok is an Autobot Powermaster from the Generation 1. Continuity Who's there? Knok is the Powermaster partner of Doubledealer. Though loyal to the Autobot cause, he's also a money-grubbing little fellow, making him a good match for the ambitious Doubledealer whose business office he helps run. When transformed into Doubledealer's power-supply engine, Knok allows him to transform to his humanoid robot mode. Little does Knok suspect the true levels of Doubledealer's duplicity—he is totally unaware of Doubledealer's Decepticon form, or the other Powermaster partner that enables it. {| class="wikitable" |

The OTM Mags are magazine attachments featured in Call of Duty: Mobile, uniquely available to the DR-H assault rifle. The OTM Mags come with two variants, 25-Round and 30-Round, and both increase head multiplier by 0.05x and upper arms by 0.2x.

:Light Units are a type of Decepticlone from the Transformers (PS2) video game in the Unicron Trilogy continuity family. Light Units are the most common cannon fodder foot soldier variety of Decepticlone. They are described as "cheap" and "easy to manufacture", hence their large numbers. Light Units are the weakest humanoid-shaped type with minimal armour and firepower, they also possess only rudimentary intelligence and combat skill. Although small in both size and threat, Light Units are effective in groups, but only when a Medium Unit or Command Unit is present to give orders. Should their squad leader be destroyed, Light Units have a tendency to quickly become disorganized. Their reaction time is very poor, not noticing approaching Autobot vehicles until they are right on top of them. Light Units' only weapon is a small laser-blaster in place of their right hand. This weapon is somewhat ineffective. However, Light Units will not waver from attacking once they have located a target; the only thing that will make them cease is their own destruction. This means that, if ignored, a Light Unit can chip away at an Autobot's armor considerably. Light Units can still be used as "runners" to acquire reinforcements, but they are not as fast as Medium Units. Light Units keep on fighting regardless of what goes on around them (such as getting a Limpet mine stuck to them) or how many of their comrades are destroyed. If a Light Unit tries to engage in melee combat with an Autobot, they

Machtackle is a dynamic duo of a machine composed of the Multiforce members Mach and Tackle. As a combatant he is skilled enough to defeat the Dinoforce, though typically he is ordered into reserve when Breastforce becomes involved. Though Machtackle can be formed in two different configurations by his two members, usually Mach forms the torso and head, while Tackle becomes the legs. Possibly this is so Tackle doesn't have to be constantly explaining things to Mach, though it is anyone's guess which of the pair would be happier about it. Trust us, the engines and tail fin look much better on top.
Like most Cybertronians, Predacons have two optics. These help them see their prey or friends and to help them watch where they fly or walk.
The No. 3 Rifle Brake is a Muzzle attachment available for all Submachine Guns and Handguns in Call of Duty: Vanguard. It helps by giving a small increase to the weapon's accuracy.

To make his life easier, Quint Quarry has an army of Q-Drones at his beck and call. These hovering drones possess an array of technology including the ability to produce energy fields, project holograms, act as a mobile surveillance network, fire bolas, and record and broadcast video.

Benjamin Sherman Crothers, a.k.a. Scatman Crothers (May 23, 1910 - November 22, 1986) was an American singer, musician, voice actor and number one super guy. He is often recognized for his roles in films such as The Shining and The Twilight Zone the Movie and for his voiceover performances such as Scat Cat in Disney's The Aristocats and as the title character in Hong Kong Phooey.

Ushiwakamaru (牛若丸) is a young samurai from the late Heian period and early Kamakura period of Japan. He is implied to be the savior that was prophesied to Benkei Musashibō, who would become Benkei's master after defeating him in combat.
Nebula V, also written Nebula 5 or N-5, is a chemical weapon featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard and Call of Duty: Warzone.

Adrian Clairmont was a hunter and leader of the Coalition strike force which devastated the Kindred of Los Angeles in 2021. A pious and ruthless member of the Society of Leopold, Adrian was a rare mortal who could wield the power of True Faith.

Ahmal is a seventh generation Assamite of the Warrior Caste. Prominent during the Medieval period, he embraced Husayn al Fatin, son of a wealthy merchant and talented with stealth, after seven years of apprenticeship.
Adrino Manauara is a powerful Tzimisce and the Anarch Baron of Manaus, Brazil.
The Nikita AVT is a bullpup assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard. It was added as part of the Season Three update.

Ambrogino Giovanni is a 5th generation Cappadocian, a childe of Lady Constancia. He is a Premascine and one of Clan Hecata's most powerful necromancers. He is also an incomparable occult scholar who has spent most of his unlife seeking out arcane texts such as the Sargon Fragment.

Anna DeVries is the founder an chief executive of the DeVries Agency. Anna DeVries founded the DeVries Agency in 1999, soon after her own eruption as a nova. She was present when Hazel Dryden, the future elite Crystalhawk, erupted with a devestating blast of sonic energy. DeVries in turn immediately manifested the ability to neutralize the powers of other novas. This can take the form of temporary suppression, though she does have an ability she called "the Brain Burner" that has proven fatal every time she uses it. So far, she has only deployed the Brain Burner when her own life was in immediate danger. An international business administrator in her own nght, Anna had the good fortune to inherit her father Holger DeVries's legacy: the remains of his business, Executive Actions, an infamous and highly successful mercenary company. When Anna came up with the idea for a freelance agency for novas, she was able to draw on existing resources and infrastructure, including a corps of baseline administrators, and quickly acquired all the capital she needed through a strategic partnership with the DeBeers diamond cartel. Anna markets her company as the world's first company "by novas, for novas," and takes pains to form a personal connection with her employees. She has directed her agency's medical staff to research the cause of infertility among novas, and she herself recently became pregnant by her on-again, off-again lover Frank Carrington. While she harbors no particular ill will
Andrew Harrison is a Homid Theurge Shadow Lord from New York.

No Limit Shipment is a Game Mode featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard. The game mode functions like its predecessor, Shipment 24/7, by featuring only the map Shipment. This version however only features the mode, Team Deathmatch, a Blitz Combat Pacing and an infinite score, in which it allows the players ten minutes to get unlimited kills until the game ends. It was a 7v7 playlist but does not feature a Hardcore variant. NoLimitShipment Promo CODV.jpg|Playlist promotional artwork.
Annie Walker is a Monkeywrencher Werewolf. Quote: Mankind survived well enough without electricity. This isn't terrorism, it's salvation.
Anansi the Spider is a God-Form spirit of Akan religion and folklore associated with stories, wisdom, knowledge, and trickery, most commonly depicted as a spider.

Annais Mazet is an eleventh generation Tremere and the sire of Nazeera. She was a descendant of Carna and a member of the Milwaukee Chantry. Following Carna's Rebellion, she joined her nascent House Carna and abandoned her childe.
The North-Industry Heavyweight Suppressor is a muzzle attachment featured in Call of Duty: Mobile, where it is available to the Type 19 assault rifle.

Anthony Ruiz is a ninth generation Lasombra of the New York Sabbat, and the sire of Hester Reed. He was addicted to the blood of junkies and Hester let him drink her blood from time to time until she almost died because of an overdose. That was when Anthony decided to Embrace her. Not a decade following Hester's embrace, she would become Ductus of a powerful local pack.

Anubis was said by some of the wraiths of Neter-Khertet (the Egyptian Shadowlands) to be the first man who ever tasted death. Others say that he was once a Garou, who chose to venture into the shadowlands to fight the influence of the Wyrm in them by giving the restless dead a safe haven. Certainly, he was ancient even when Charon passed into the underworld and he had explored the afterlife extensively by the time the Stygian empire arose. He is the protector of the Egyptian underworld of Amenti, a character spiritually akin to the Lady of Fate, and he taught Osiris the Shadowlands section of the great rite that turns mortals into Immortals, in the hopes that they might safeguard Neter-Khertet. Because of this enigmatic wraith, an entity who could be said to have risen to some greater status among the spiritual pantheon, Amenti enjoys the status of the capital of the Immortal Shadow Realms. Hidden completely from unwelcome attentions, it does still manage to enjoy a strong relationship with the Ferrymen, who are indebted to Anubis.
Argemone, also known as the Pet, is a mighty Hobgoblin beast of the Hedge.
The Nekomancer is a wonder weapon featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 Zombies in the map Kowakujō. The Nekomancer is a talking cat that the player can wield as a weapon following a short quest.
Exotic, arousing and irresistibly charismatic, Anya Z (Dark Bubasti Siren) is an Bastet, has become a near-goddess in the modern music underground.

Arnold is the eldest Noseratu in Night City, back when it was still named Morro Bay. He probably knows more about the goings on in the city than either Helen or Carlo. He is always willing to talk to those who would listen, but only about day to day events. He will only bring up the information he has if he feels he has a good reason for it. Arnold is a Ninth Generation Kindred Embraced in 1947 and a W.W.II Veteran.
Arcadian Walsh is a 9th Generation Elder Malkavian who lives in Dallas, Texas, acting as a Justicar for the Camarilla.
Nikita may refer to: *Nikita Dragovich- An antagonist in Call of Duty: Black Ops. *Nikita AVT - A bullpup assault rifle in Call of Duty: Vanguard and Call of Duty: Warzone.

Asphyx is the unique Discipline of the Brothers of Ypres, a bloodline forged in the trenches of World War I by Kindred doused in toxic chemicals. Asphyx is a discipline for committing chemical warfare against the enemy; because chemical poisoning has little effect on the undead vampires, its use is mainly against mortals and other supernatural beings.

Athena Boyd is a member of Project Utopia's Internal Affairs Inspection Teams. She enjoys her work and does not show off her nova powers. Boyd is unique in that she is both idealistic and savvy. She knows the world is not perfect, but she enjoys making it more so. Project Utopia Employees (Including members of Team Tomorrow) who misuse their authority have cause to fear her.
Asima is the Ghoul handmaiden of the powerful Lasombra Fatimah al-Lam'a, residing in Cairo. She is gifted with the ability to see through any form of supernatural invisibility.
Ordnance Training is a Vehicle Perk featured in Call of Duty: World at War that is unlocked at level 12 and allows a tank's cannon to reload 30% faster than normal.

Barghests, or bloodhounds, are wraiths who have been Moliated into monstrous shapes and “lobotomized” by the grafting of a specially prepared muzzle of Stygian steel to their Corpus. The wraith who holds the corresponding “whistle” for a brace of barghests controls their actions. Barghests are animalistic and feral, but have extremely keen senses and are completely obedient to their controller. They are used as hunters and assassins by the Hierarchy. Braces of barghests search the Shadowlands for wraiths (or other beings) who bear significant amounts of Oblivion taint and destroy them.

Bernardo Veneducci is a mage and the founder of the Milano Hollow Chantry in Milan, Italy. He purchased a defunct hotel near the Duomo Cathedral and renovated it, creating comfortable living quarters for himself and ample room for Italian Hollowers and guests.
Billy Budd was a Wraith-turned-Spectre who lived in the 19th century United States.

The Opel Blitz is a truck that has made appearances in all Call of Duty games set in World War II. It has also made appearances in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, Call of Duty: Black Ops, Call of Duty: Black Ops III, and Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War.
Beatrice Lancaster is a Lasombra ancilla of the Camarilla, operating in the area of Seattle, Tacoma, and Bellevue, Washington with her coterie. In life, she was a bootlegger during Prohibition.

Black Tooth, also known as the Dark Lord, was a midnight-black Simba who nearly exterminated the Ajaba and ruled Africa for a long time with cruelty and efficiency. Even after his fall, he is seen by many Simba as the epitome of their kind, how great they can be and how bestial and cruel they can be.

Black Lotus, born Nina Barker, is a 10th generation Serpent of the Light and member of the Widows pack within the Sabbat. She looks much younger than she really is. Her delicate frame and innocent face are deceiving, hiding the cruel monster inside.

Private Olszewski is a soldier of the Polish First Armored Division and was one of the tank crewmen whose tank is destroyed while fighting in "The Mace". He appeared just after the player's tank is destroyed where he will help Bohater Wojciech and his squad fight off the Germans. He typically dies before the player reaches Kolwalski and the rest of the squad. However, it is possible to keep him alive. If the player manages to do so, he will stay behind crates right before the player has met up with the rest of the squad. Olszewski enfield cod3.PNG|Olszewski armed with a Lee-Enfield.

Bithewaye the Elder was a vampire of the Invictus of London who was active at some point prior to the reign of . Thought to have been killed by traitorous Spanish envoys, he was, in truth, staked and left out in the sun by his childe, Richard Bithewaye.
Bjarne the Bear is a thirteenth generation Gangrel alleycat and a member of Emerie Alveston's coterie that destroyed the blood cult known as the Reformed Evangelical Church of the Redeemer.

Brand Gyrdsson is an Valdaermen Mage from Scandinavia during the Dark Ages. He was the cabal leader of Ulf's Hall. He dies from an infection caused from a battle with the Gangrel, Halvard Firemane, who was also slain.
Olive Camouflage is a weapon camouflage in Call of Duty: Black Ops, and was set to be in Call of Duty: World at War before it was cut from the retail game.

Brother Owl combines the roles of alchemist, necromancer, and priest to serve those in need. As an alchemist, he rebuilds and renews broken things in run-down communities. As a necromancer, he pacifies angry ghosts and relays whatever they never got a chance to tell the living. These all fulfill a basic commitment to the priesthood even if, after abandoning his church, it’s a priesthood of one. He still wears the old Episcopal “dog collar” along with the rugged clothes he needs for a traveler’s life. He still believes in God, but has no taste for any particular faith. He’s loosely associated with the Silver Ladder, but believes that humanity can’t return to glory without getting its collective house in order first.

Bronze Heart is an Arisen. He is best known for being active in France during the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reign_of_Terror Reign of Terror,] as described in Chronicles of Darkness: Dark Eras 2. Belonging to the Maa-Kep, Bronze Heart is a true Bull. He often snorts, judges everyone he meets (to determine if they should be gored, or trampled, of course), and enjoys physically mauling those who do not show his guild proper respect. If he wishes to keep a low profile, he will often disguise himself as a disgruntled, but diligent worker.
Daedalus of Athens, also known as Daedalus the Great, was one of the first Artificers and thus one of the founders of what would later be regarded as technomancy.
The Oscar II is the second variant of the Oscar-Class of Russian guided missile submarine-types which appears in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3.
D.Z. Schillinger is an Eleventh Generation Tzimisce veterinarian. He is one of several Ready-Made Player Characters found in V20 Ready Made Characters.

Dante Rosselini is a Giovanni of the Rossellini family. He summoned and tortured the soul of the destroyed Emma Blake in order to discover the location of Cuthbert Beckett's London haven. He used her to blackmail Beckett for quarter of a century. Beckett assumed that she may still be in Rosselini's possession in current nights.
Dauud was a Setite sorcerer working for the Clan Tremere during the Dark Ages.

Over Reactor is a Special Ops Mission Mode mission in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3. It requires the player to infiltrate a submarine in danger of having a nuclear reactor meltdown and then escape in a helicopter.
Demosia, was a former goddess of Night and the Occult, in the Long-lost Atlantean Pantheon .
Darnell Wallace was a Wraith who lived in the 19th century United States.
David Geduld is a 10th generation Ventrue vampire and one of the prominent kindred in the Anarch Free States of Los Angeles during the mid-1990s.
Odysseus is the ninth mission in Call of Duty: Black Ops II that takes place on the U.S.S. Barack Obama. After capturing Raul Menendez, the ship comes under attack.

Doctor Donald Roe was the director of Bishopsgate Mental Asylum from 1917 to 1920. He is currently one of the ghosts on Bishopsgate's board of directors.

Don Paulo is a Lasombra neonate knight and the childe of Don Roland. During the Dark Ages, he was sent as an emissary to the Courts of Love to deal with Isouda de Blaise in an attempt to gain Toreador favour for his sire.

The Octane Camouflage is a DLC weapon camouflage skin available for Call of Duty: Black Ops II. It is available for anyone who buys the Octane Pack. The camouflage is a recoloured version of the Desert Coyote camouflage.
Lady Edana is an Unseelie Sidhe Wilder of House Balor in Hibernia.
Efraín Barrera (likely not the name he had at the time of his Embrace) is a tlahuelpuchi residing in northern Mexico.

Eirik Longtooth is a wild Scandinavian Gangrel of the Dark Ages, and the leader of the Free State in Finland. He was supported in his efforts by Ulfsdottir, who kept the peace in the realm and kept Eirik's power in check, as his disdain against Christianity might turn him against fellow Christian cainites.

The Ohm is a directed-energy Heavy Weapon featured in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare, released with the Ascendance DLC. It was made available to Season Pass holders on Xbox consoles on March 3rd, 2015 and April 2nd, 2015 for the other consoles.
An Erdgeist (also known as Nisseling, Flinteeth, or Se-Gihes) is a type of earth-elemental spirit that appears as a small man with jagged, rocky teeth.
Eyes of the Cat is a rank 3 Metis Gift. This allows the Garou to see clearly in complete darkness. The Garou's eyes will glow lambent green while this Gift is in effect. It is taught by a cat-spirit.
Fatima Saieed is a Lasombra psychologist at Harvard that studies the relation between her clan and darkness in a strictly scientific manner.
Operation Port Armor is the third campaign level in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare.

The Fae of Lundenwic, true name unknown, was a True Fae and self-styled queen who, during the Saxon invasions of England, made a bargain with the vampiric leader of the Weihan Cynn to keep safe an artifact known as the Trophy. In the late 1500s, she returned with a contingent to retrieve that artifact, promising dire retribution upon the local Kindred should they fail to recover it. Little is known definitively of the Other, but it was strong enough to instantly reduce a vampire to ash with a mere gesture.
Ezekiel Hatter was a Wraith who lived in the 19th century United States.
Fiorenza Savona is an ascending kingpin of the clan Ventrue, and acting Ventrue Premier of Mexico City.
Operation Taken Dagger is a ship assault mission in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare.
Fräulein Kirchin is a Hollow One mage and caretaker of the Hohe Strasse Halfway House Chantry in Cologne, Germany.
Fukutenjin is a Kitsune who has entered human mythology as a goddess of good fortune.
Ghost Tooth is a coyote-spirit that has a fondness for the Essence of human ghosts.
Operation Phoenix is a ship assault mission in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare.

Giangaleazzo, born Gian Galeazzo Visconti, is the Lasombra Prince of Milan. He is widely known for his spectacular defection from the Sabbat to the Camarilla, making him one of the single most reviled vampires on the Sabbat's list.
Gladius ("Standing Jaws") is the intermediary form of Rokea. A powerful war form that incites weak delirium. The Same-Bito refer to this form as "Karvu."
Gottfried is an influential child vampire in Aachen (Aix-la-Chappelle).
Operation D-Con is a ship assault mission in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It sees the infiltration of the SDS Hellas, an SDF ship containing several chemical weapons onboard.
]] Gregornous Deathwing is one of the draconic seven Zmei of Russia. Anyone who hears his hex scream risks being cursed with calamity.
Green Dragon is a Wyrm totem of the Beast-of-War and former patron spirit of the White Howlers.
Gunther is a seventh generation Nosferatu antitribu and the childe of Strohmann, the Sabbat Archbishop of Berlin. His retainers, along with Marie ambushed her sire, the Gangrel Cuthbert Beckett.
Operation Deep Execute is a ship assault mission in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare.

Lawrence Pohl, more often known by his deed-name "Graynail", was a Silver Fang ahroun and the de facto leader of his tribe at the Broad Brook Sept at the time of its destruction. He also often served as the sept's warmaster.

Gretya is an eighth generation Ravnos and childe of the powerful Zlato, from Durga Syn's bloodline. She is a young Rroma recently embraced from a Phuri Dae family. She took part in the Ravnos' efforts against Baba Yaga in Russia.

Guido is the ghoul of the Ventrue Gino Manitelli, and part of the Washington Camarilla. He does all of Gino's dirty work. Gino was once a reserve lineman for the , until he was Blood Bound and Dominated, becoming the perfect tool for Gino's purposes.
Captain Oren Emin is an antagonist who appears in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare and member of the Settlement Defense Front. He's assigned to the SetDef warship, Nerio.
Grigor Wallach was a tenth generation Tremere of Jerusalem. He is part of Denelem Obfusco's coterie and is destroyed, while performing dark rituals upon a captive cainite.

Harzomatuili is (was) the leader of the Mexico City Sept of Black Spiral Dancers and their Hell-Pit Hive Caern which in modern times would eventually evolve into The Underbelly of the Wyrm. He first appeared in print as the Leader of the Sepulchre in the Mage: the Ascension book The Chaos Factor, then later in Werewolf: The Wild West supplement Tales from the Trails: Mexico and finally in the card game Vampire: The Eternal Struggle. A Garou of prodigious age and immense power, Harzomatuili has maintained his station as leader of all of Mexico's Black Spiral Dancers for centuries, since the time of Hernan Cortes' conquest of Mexico in 1519 CE. He has done this not simply through the grace of the Wyrm and his own guile and ambition, but by consuming kindred vitae to prolong his life; specifically, by drinking blood provided to him by the late Sabbat Regent Melinda Galbraith, though he remains free of any Blood Bond, and any benefits of being a ghoul other than prolonged life remain absent from his in game stats. What is also unclear is whether or not Harzomatuili is a convert to the way of the Wyrm from another tribe, or if he is Black Spiral Dancer descended from the long fallen White Howlers of old. Harzomatuili further claims to be "one of the Blessed of the Wyrm, a chosen warrior in the battle against the forces of the Wyld" and one of the first among the Wyrmbringers (Wyrmcomers). His level of accomplishment and renown very likely could prove this boast true: he was in lar

Hansen is a seventh generation Toreador with the appearance of a young boy. Living in St. Louis, he romanced a sixteen-year-old Lucina for months. He Embraced Lucina but then abandoned her, regretting the act and finding her mundane.
The Omsk Hammer is a melee weapon featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered. It also appears as a prop in Call of Duty: WWII.

Helissente is a seventh generation Brujah of Medieval Spain, and the sire of Don Cerro. Don Cerro attracted her attention with his passion for justice, and one night she challenged him for a fight. Instead, he tried to persuade her to stand down and for this, she Embraced him. Helissente was a follower of the way of the ancient warrior-philosophers of the Clan, seeking perfection of both body and mind.

Henry of Castile is an eighth generation Lasombra of Spain, and the sire of Eustace Lancaster. He Embraced Eustace from the English courts and used him as his tool for the Jyhad, destroying the Lasombra's cainite opponents.
The Hornet's Nest is an Immundus, a Hell-corrupted spirit, that manifests as a swarm of insects.

On Point is a Rare gun perk that appears in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare, found upon certain weapon variants. It speeds up the aim down sights time of weaponry and reduces hip fire accuracy. The speed up to aim down sights time stacks with the Quick Draw attachment.

Honor Mercer is the Gangrel childe of Mark Decker, Prince of Milwaukee. She is rebellious and ran away from his "care" to the city of Indianapolis. Honor is keen to learn about the Anarch Movement, and specifically the Ministry. Her sire kept her ignorant of this, except to insist the Anarchs were a danger to all Kindred. Now she is applying herself to studying their theory and methodology. Honor wants to unseat Decker and deliver the city to the Anarchs. Maybe she will end up as Baron, maybe not. It doesn’t matter. She doesn’t care much for authority figures, however, following her experience with Decker.

"Ikopabe" is an Antediluvian and a silent beast of a hunter, said to personify that Beast more than any other vampire. He appears as a member of the Apostates, in the Fair is Foul scenario, from the Gehenna sourcebook.

Ihuitl was an eagle warrior who lived during the time of the Aztec Empipre. A lifelong explorer, Ihuitl disregarded any notion of sacred forbidden lands, traveling as he pleased. As such, he was the only known individual to have discovered the Lost Valley, home to surviving populations of several dinosaur species. He was unable to convince his fellows to follow him to the valley to learn about and take the skins of the dinosaurs within, and began to consider going to the jaguar warriors instead. It remains unknown whether he actually did so, however.

The Odin Weapon Kit is a Legendary weapon kit featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered that was added in the December 13, 2016‎ update. It is available for all Light Machine Guns. The Odin weapon kit can be obtained from a Supply Drop or bought for 1300 Parts. It is a piece of the Norse collection. The kit features a white and grey camouflage among the weapon, coupled with a scribe of the word "Valhalla". The M249 SAW features a slight difference, sporting two red lines on the belt box.
Isis is an Egyptian nature goddess. She is the wife and sister of Osiris.

Jakob was an eighth generation Nosferatu and the cult leader of the Wellspring. Jakob is the childe of Prince Belinde Buch of Copenhagen. Jakob recently became a deranged wight and a coterie was responsible for destroying him.

{{Infobox VTM character | name = Izukanne | image = | caption = | clan = Giovanni {Ghiberti) | sire = Magno di Giovanni | embrace = Early 18th century | path = Death and the Soul }} Izukanne is a Giovanni necromancer of the Ghiberti family line. He resides in Africa where he has a tense relationship with the Laibon.

One-Two is a Legendary gun perk that appears in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare, found upon certain weapon variants. It grants bonuses to the player's Payload or Fate and Fortune Card meters when achieving a melee kill.
Jeremiah Moorcock was the director of Bishopsgate Hospital from 1954 to 1973. He currently is one of the ghosts making up the Board of Directors.

Jason Milliner is an ambitious Milliner vampire of the Giovanni and Hecata Clans. He seized Prince Quentin King III's weakness and acquired power in Boston, along with Andreas Giovanni and Stephano Giovanni.
In 1865, Jeremiah Lassater and his partners incorporated into Premium Oil. In 1892, he made an unholy pact with a mighty Wyrm-beast, granting it control of Premium Oil through him.

Overcharge is an Epic gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It is exclusive to the R-VN - Blowout variant. It allows to weapon to create a small cone explosion when the player kills an enemy with the weapon in its melee form.
John Diamond is probably the most powerful Tremere born in North America. Pontifex of North America responsible for business. Made his haven in Bridgeport, Connecticut.

Dr. John Dee bani Bonisagus was a mage of the Order of Hermes (House Bonisagus) who was Embraced into the Tremere clan of vampires in 1607 CE. He now acts as the Pontifex of the British Islands and is a persistent rival to the Prince of London.
Julius was a powerful Brujah archon who served under the Justicar Jaroslav Pascek. He met his Final Death at the siege of Atlanta in 1999.

Operator Mods are an attachment variation available in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4. An operator mod modifies a weapon's behavior in a fundamental way, to a greater degree than regular attachments. Furthermore, operator mods require a special Wildcard (the Primary Operator Mod or Secondary Operator Mod) in order to be equipped.
Johnny Sweets (almost definitely an alias), also known by his username on dating apps 'Everloved1', is a wilder changeling exploiting modern online dating culture to harvest Glamour.

Joseph Cambridge is an eighth generation Nosferatu of Los Angeles, and the sire of Juan Antonio Lopez de Aguirre. He beat up a mortal Juan and ended up embracing him. A newly-deformed Juan Antonio fled his sire all the way to Mexico City and joined the Sabbat.
Jon Courier is a Nosferatu and a Camarilla agent. During the Sabbat Firedance campaign, he reports on the Sabbat's activity and Marston Colchester's plans to his master Calebros, in New York City.

Operation Arcane is a multiplayer map in Call of Duty: WWII that is exclusive to the War Mode setting a battle between the 65th Infantry Division, "Battle-Axe" and German 39th Mountain Division over the destruction or protection of secret Axis technology in a secret research facility in St. Georgen an der Gusen, Austria. It was released in the Shadow War downloadable content pack.

Joseph O'Grady is a 7th generation Ventrue antitribu resident of Mexico City. He is the Ductus of the El Calpulli Rojo Sabbat pack. Forced into an existence of brutality, O'Grady tried convincing himself he was a fiend and a monster before he explored a Path of Honorable Accord.
Kendi, the Frill-Necked Lizard, is a totem of Strength of the Wyrm.

Ketil Svensson is an Valdaermen Mage from Scandinavia during the Dark Ages. He is a member of the cabal at Ulf's Hall. He is stabbed in the throat and killed by the Nosferatu, Ludwik, disguised as a villager.
The is a bullpup assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Mobile, and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4.

Not to be confused with Steals-the-Wind Kokopelli Steals-The-Wind is a Nuwisha. He spends most of his time in the Umbra, except when he drops in and out of the physical world to make sure he is judging the passage of time right.
A Kwannon-jin of the Eastern Hsien, the Komuko are elemental nobles; Kamuii Shinma of the element of Earth. They are often mistakenly referred to as Changelings.
Kirijama, "The Hidden Foe" is the hidden enemy. It has no manifested form that can be perceived by human or Garou.
Oruzhie (Cyrillic: Оружие) is a weapon manufacturer in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare.

Koli was a Blood Talon Uratha who fought alongside Ingólfr and Eirik. Though Koli was still moving near the end of the battle that killed Eirik, it is unlikely he would live for long, as Ingólfr counted him as among the fallen.

Lawrence Meeks is a Nosferatu spy, and one of the most influential vampires that New Orleans has ever known. A very tall, gaunt Nosferatu, Lawrence made his haven at the Old State Capitol in Baton Rouge.

The Lady of the Lake is a True Fae who stands guard over the mythic sword Excalibur — or at least a Token that mimics the relic. Though the current state of the Other is unknown, during the late 1500s, she was involved in the crusade of the Loyalist Arthur Caxton to recreate Camelot. Either bound by some frailty or simply uninterested in taking others, she left only with Caxton's body when the madman fell and his opponents tossed Excalibur's scabbard into her lake.

On-Hand is a Weapon Kit available in Call of Duty: Vanguard and Call of Duty: Warzone. It helps to decrease the time in between using Equipment and switching back to a weapon. This is available on all Assault Rifles, Submachine Guns, Light Machine Guns, Marksman Rifles, Sniper Rifles and Handguns

Latebra Uberto Ascheri is a Toreador Anarch and neonate of Milan. They are a genderfluid singer and former drug addict. A rebel in both life and unlife, they support the Anarch Movement because it gives their nights purpose and meaning. Latebra joins an Anarch coterie of young and promising vampires that seek to dethrone the ruthless Prince Prospero.
Lee Ann Milner is a mage and the signature character of the Cult of Ecstasy.
Long-Arm Jack is the unusually-honorable Other who lives within the Hardscrabble Home, a pitiless wilderness where his servants work.

The Otero Red Dot is a Red Dot sight featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It is classed as a Universal Attachment and unlocking it for the weapon it is unlocked under, unlocks it for the entire weapon class. It is available for the majority of weapon classes, excluding Sniper Rifles and Pistols.
Little Sister is a junior Child of Gaia theurge residing in the American Midwest. Little Sister is one of the signature characters of the Shattered Nation sourcebook.

Lucita de Aragón is the signature character of the Lasombra clan in Vampire: The Masquerade and Dark Ages: Vampire. She is a consummate shadow warrior, rivaling the Assamites in ferocity and reputation. As the Anarch Revolt ensued and the Sabbat formed from its ashes, Lucita abstained from both sects, becoming one of the most feared Lasombra antitribu active in the modern nights. But all of this changed with the Final Death of her sire – an event that drove her to follow in his footsteps by becoming the Sabbat Archbishop of Madrid. Alongside her companions Anatole and Beckett, Lucita is one of the foremost authorities on the Final Nights and the signs of the Ancients' awakening.

Lukas Atkins (also known as Outruns-His-Mistakes) is a Homid Silent Strider Theurge in the American Wild West. He is described as being a "mulatto", and appears, alongside Jonas Moon, Learns-The-Old-Ways, Aaron Walks-With-Steel, and a young werewolf implied to be Arthur Sperling, in the prologue for Werewolf: The Wild West. He was involved in saving a number of passengers from a trainwreck by alerting the train's engineer of the dismantled train tracks, and was among the werewolves that turned a notable Wendigo caern to prevent a railroad from being built over it.

The Otero Micro Dot is a red dot sight featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It is classed as a Universal Attachment and unlocking it for the weapon it is unlocked under, unlocks it for the entire weapon class. It is available for Assault Rifles, SMGs, Shotguns and Pistols.
Lucretia the Cess Queen is an infamous Nosferatu known for her heavily diseased bite and tainted blood.

Machete Paul is one of the more apparent members of the reclusive Aquarii line of the Gangrel. He claims the docks and waters around New York as his domain, hunting kine instead of maritime lifeforms like many of his kind.
Lyle Grand was a private investigator looking into a particular relic in the shape of an apple and the three deaths it caused. He was known to use his skills as a medium to aid in his investigations.

The Otero Thermal 2x is a thermal optic featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It is classed as a Universal Attachment and unlocking it for the weapon it is unlocked under, unlocks it for the entire weapon class. It is available for Assault Rifles, SMGs, LMGs, Marksman Rifles and Sniper Rifles.
Madame Paula was an influential Tzimisce and Koldun sorceress who participated in the Siege of Atlanta in 1999.
Magenta is a wraith who in life was a massive movie buff and one of the early adopters of Goth fashion.

Malcolm Entwhistle is a Kindred Sheriff of the London Camarilla. He secretly serves the Mithras-possessed Montgomery Coven. Under Mithras' orders, he eliminates the Sabbat Inquisition pack under Declan Whitacker, and then shifts his attention to sabotaging the local Tremere.

Ol' Tessie, casually referred to as the Wonder Vehicle, is a driveable utility featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 Zombies in the map Ashes of the Damned, a stationary turret in Astra Malorum, and as a stationary Pack-a-Punch Machine in the Survival map Ashwood. In Ashes of the Damned, it primarily serves as the player's means of transportation between the various places of interest around the map. Ol' Tessie can be upgraded with several weapons as well as the Pack-a-Punch Machine.

Madison Wolfe is a young Gangrel of London, and the Fledgling sire of Sanjay Ali. Sanjay's life ended in a fateful encounter with the newly Embraced Madison, who was fleeing her sire. Scared, confused, and experiencing a hunger like nothing she had ever felt, Madison fell upon the boy, sinking her fangs into him. The next thing Sanjay remembers is being fed her blood. He panicked and pushed her away, fleeing into the night.
Mari Cabrah is a renowned Garou, a homid Theurge of the Black Furies.

The nephew of one of the founders of Emerson, Mattlew, Cutley, and Smythe, Attourneys at Law, Marcus Cutley is the 90-year-old senior partner and the only original name still working for the law firm. Though rumors abound that Marcus would be stepping down soon, they are all wrong because his still physically fit and has a steel trap mind for legal affairs. The city's most powerful and rich trust their business to no one else. His doctors warn him and tell him to take it easy at his age but Marcus still works late into the evening. It is those evening clients that pay the best. And not in cash, but in Vampire blood, for Marcus is a ghoul employed by the Ventrue Clan.
The Oris 8.6 is a bolt-action marksman rifle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4.
Marie Thibodeux was a Medium who lived in the 19th century United States.

Marius Drake was a powerful seventh generation Tremere of London. He was executed by Prince Mithras for Embracing Julie Foster without permission. His childe was saved from execution by the influential Ventrue Siegfried.
Margot d'Estrées is a 10th generation Brujah. She is the Ringmistress and cult leader of the Carnaval Moriendi, during the Dark Medieval.

The PPSh-41 is a submachine gun featured in all the World War II-based Call of Duty games that have a Soviet campaign, as well as many games of the Black Ops series, and Call of Duty: WWII, Call of Duty: Vanguard, Call of Duty: Mobile, and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4.

Markos Petrou (originally Steiner) is a powerful Tremere of Athens. Hailing from Vienna, he moved to Athens in the early 20th century. He is the sire of Persa, and the adopted sire and boss of the Caitiff.
Michael Scot is a Master Archmage of House Ex Miscellanea of the Order of Hermes in Edinburgh, Scotland and Master of the Auld Covenant.
